callees.name: validate_llm_setting
callees.pre_condition: key is a non-empty string; value is a string.
callees.post_condition: Returns normally when value is a valid setting for key. Raises an exception when key or value fails the LLM setting validation criteria.

callees.name: dotenv_values
callees.post_condition: When env_path identifies an existing, readable .env file, returns a dict mapping each defined variable name to its string value. When env_path does not identify an existing file, returns an empty dict.
